title: Kagamine Rin — Cheering Front And Center!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...!
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Your footwork looks much better now...♪
And I think you'll look even sharper if you can get your lower and upper body to move in sync more!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you! Then, I'll try that again while keeping what you just said in mind.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Idol me is doing her best again today.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Are you looking at each SEKAI again, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I was just looking at the one with idol me. I think she's having dance practice right now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, dance practice?
She works so hard every day!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I just went over to see the DJ me.
He and Rin were playing rock paper scissors to see who gets the last cookie.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. Sounds like they're having another fun day.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I'm still amazed by how each version of us is so different.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I know, right?
But I really love every version of me♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! Same here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: By the way, Rin, what do you like most about them?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. First, you know how band me is really cheerful and gives everyone cute nicknames?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ichi, Sakki, Hona, Shih!
I really like the way she thinks!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, the others don't really use nicknames or anything.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Exactly♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then there's idol me.
I really love her amazing work ethic!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Even when it comes to super complicated dances that look impossible, she'll keep practicing and picking away at it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, and it's incredible how she always gets it right in the end! I could learn a lot from her example.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Now, what do you think about the you that's partnered with DJ me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
My favorite part about that SEKAI's me is...
Hehe. How there's a bit of a gap.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A gap?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Remember what you just said, Len?
We were playing rock paper scissors for a cookie, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Day to day, they like to hang out and have fun together. But when it comes to events, they always put on these super cool performances.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Now that you mention it, everyone in that SEKAI sort of has two sides to them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Even though they mostly just spend their time at MEIKO's cafe and get scolded by her after doing something naughty, they'll suddenly start doing these really cool things.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, especially KAITO and Luka!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think the opposite of that is the version of me who puts on all those shows with her troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Her attitude's always, “We're putting on a show? Yippee☆”! Her pure enthusiasm makes everyone around her smile, and I really like that about her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I do like how they're always sharing information about the things they think seem fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which I guess makes sense since they all do shows together. Their bonds must be really strong.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Who's left...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The me that likes to be by herself. She's totally different from the me who loves doing shows.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you like about her?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. How she can be curt but still has Mafuyu and the others' best interests in mind.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And the way she sings...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Her voice is so beautiful.
And she channels all her feelings into each song.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I bet we'd sound amazing if we sang together right now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I know she's me, but the way she blushed was so cute.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, you've been keeping a pretty close eye on all of them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Of course I have.
I mean, you've been learning about your other selves too, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then, it's your turn to talk!
Tell me what you like about them!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh?
Okay, but don't laugh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, you're blushing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, what did I just say?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe!
